text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my day off, while walking through town 
with Winning Ticket—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Do I see some frills over in that 
direction...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking over, an Umamusume was pacing back 
and forth along the side road, swishing 
her tail...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ahhhhhh!! I got it, it's Yuki-chan!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Heeeeeeeeeey! Yuki-chaaaaaaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hawaa, it was you, Ticket-san!? I thought 
an avalanche had hit or something!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sorry, sorry! More importantly, 
what're you up to right now? Shopping?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Auuugh, the thing is~...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Since it's my day off and all, I figured 
I'd work up the courage to buy some 
stylish clothes.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
To become a splendid "City Girl"...! 
Buuut...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I stick out in my school uniform, and 
there are so many folks around, I couldn't 
take a single step from right here!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see~? I don't really get it, but it 
sounds like you're in trouble.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Then let's go shopping together! I was 
just thinking I wanted to look at some 
clothes!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't possibly drag a "city girl" 
like Ticket-zo-san along with me!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehhhhk!? M-Me, a City Girl-!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No, no, when you say "City girl," you 
obviously mean someone stylish, just like 
City!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"No way! Ticket-san, you're a fine 'city 
girl' yourself!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Even clothes that'd look like loungewear 
on me, you manage to wear them so 
stylishly!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ehh~, r-really? Ehehe, you think so...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's right, that's right! Ticket-zo-san, 
how do you go about picking out your 
clothes?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh, ease of movement is number one... 
and after that, getting hand-me-downs from 
my big bro!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's a little big, but it matches my style 
perfectly♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I see~...! So that's why it looks so 
naturally stylish.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"In my case, how should I choose so it 
looks stylish without looking like I'm 
trying too hard?!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uuuuugh? Honestly, I don't understand 
fashion at allll...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Trainer-saa~n!! HEEEELP!!
choice_data_list: Search thoroughly for what suits you best!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ohh, that kinda looks like it!?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: O-Ooooohhhhh—!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "Amaaazing! A fashion proverb!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haaah! That's Ticket-san's Trainer for ya!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Alright! So all we gotta do now is search 
thoooo-roughly for clothes that suit 
Yuki-chan!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm beggin' ya! I've made up my mind too!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's a deal! Time to hunt for some 
clothes~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, for the rest of that day, we 
walked through the city until our legs 
gave out, debating this and that the 
entire time.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ngh!? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah!! Come to think of it, City-san said 
the exact same thing!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"If you have an image of who you want to 
be, you have to endure high heels and bare 
skin in the winter."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Choosing what suits you is fine. But 
styling yourself to fit something is 
stylish too, right?" That's what she said!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Woooow~~~...! As expected of City, the 
Master of Fashion!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Gasp, wait!? If you're saying the exact 
same thing as that fashion guru, does that 
mean...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gasp!! Ticket-san's Trainer, too...!?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: It's the Fashion Grandmaster~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yuki-chan, let's get lots of advice from 
our fashion master today!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! If our Style Master picks the 
clothes, there's no way you can go wrong!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Overvalued by the two honest girls, she 
was bombarded with requests for opinions 
during their subsequent shopping trip.
